_comment: SYNTHETIC minimal fixture for assess_case.assess_child (case-engineer 13, OI-62, verification 08 hole A3). NOT a returned run: every number is a placeholder chosen so the child is ADMISSIBLE, and the tests in scripts/check_platelet_diagnostic_semantics.py change only the platelet fields. It replaces the absent preflight/20260906-101812 fixture that left the end-to-end test SKIPPED. spec holds exactly the keys assess_child reads for this child (found by recording every access on a generated P73_G4_r3_40 spec); advect_released false skips the transport report and end_time_s 0.001 matches the last Time line. controls are the real mainCaseControls.json. log_template placeholders: {PLATELET_<t>} = the PHASE_CLOT_PLATELET record at that time, {DRY} = the dryFacesConducting suffix of the PHASE_CLOT_PLATELET_FO line.
